content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-A1, REQ-A4, REQ-A5; AC-2

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-backend/src/classifier/client.rs — add `async fn recommend(&self, req: RecommendRequest) -> Result<RecommendResponse, ClassifierError>` to the trait. Implement in TonicClassifierClient (uses the new tonic-generated client) and FixtureClassifierClient (returns canned responses for tests).

**Rust quality**:
- 15s default timeout per REQ-A5 (operator-configurable via existing classifier config)
- Reuse polaris-backend/src/classifier/budget.rs Semaphore + circuit.rs breaker (no new resource primitives)
- Errors map to existing ClassifierError variants (Timeout, Transport, BadResponse)
- Doctest on recommend()

**Tests**:
- tests/classifier_recommend_roundtrip.rs — FixtureClassifierClient returns canned RecommendResponse; round-trip via the trait

**Blocked by**: #LLM-1
